facts.text: First-year students at American University can participate in the year-long AU Cornerstone Program, choosing between D.C. career and internship preparation or study abroad in Madrid or Dublin.

sources.title: AU Cornerstone Program | American University, Washington, DC
sources.quote: Students get to choose one of the three year-long Cornerstone Programs: the D.C. career/internship preparation program, a study abroad program in Madrid during their Fall semester (for SIS Scholars only), or a study abroad program in Dublin

facts.text: Under American University's residency requirement, incoming students must live in university housing for their first and second year.

sources.quote: Students are required to live in campus housing their first and second year.

facts.text: Degree students at American University can cross-register for courses at other member institutions through the Consortium of Universities of the Washington Metropolitan Area.

sources.title: Consortium Registration | American University, Washington, DC
sources.quote: The Consortium of Universities of the Washington Metropolitan Area combines the resources of area universities and colleges. American University offers qualified degree students the opportunity to enroll for courses at any of these institutions.
